text:
michael: Heads up — we're seeing ~4hr lag for tenant 'acme-prod' in the Console. Hourly rows missing for 03:00-06:00 UTC, charts show empty bars. Noticed an ingest-replay job failure around 03:12 UTC.
emily: Can you paste the tenant/org id and a repro query?
michael: org_id=7421. Query I ran:
```
SELECT count(*) FROM hourly_usage
WHERE org_id=7421
  AND ts >= '2026-03-15 03:00'
  AND ts <  '2026-03-15 07:00';
```
returns 0, last successful row at 02:00.
raj: I'm on call, will triage. Can someone check kafka consumer lag and ingest-replay logs? @sasha @support-bot
support-bot: Alert: ingest-replay job failed (job=ingest-replay-20260315-0312) exit=1 at 2026-03-15T03:12:07Z — error: "timeout writing to s3"
sasha: Consumer group `analytics-ingest` shows big lag on partitions 4-7. Controller moved leaders at 03:10, looks like a leader shuffle. Consumers on ingest-2/3 didn't catch up.
raj: I restarted consumer on ingest-3. Lag dropping but backfill aborted earlier. Can someone try a manual backfill with dedupe?
emily: Running manual backfill now: `run_backfill --org 7421 --from 2026-03-15T03:00 --to 2026-03-15T07:00` -> job 7892. Logs show: `ERROR: duplicate key value violates unique constraint "hourly_usage_pkey" at 2026-03-15T03:18:22Z` — backfill aborted.
sasha: That duplicate-key abort is new — last deploy changed idempotency mode on the writer. Backfill doesn't switch to upsert, so it fails when partial data exists.
michael: Customer sees incorrect/empty charts in Console. Can we do a quick fix (upsert) so backfill completes?
raj: Opening hotfix: switch backfill writer to upsert mode, re-run with dedupe enabled. Will flip flag and kick off job in ~10m.
emily: Copy — will monitor job and console after completion.
raj: Hotfix applied -> re-run backfill job 7893 (upsert/dedupe). Logs: `INFO rows_processed=14532 rows_upserted=14532 duration=00:12:08` :white_check_mark:
emily: Verified in Console — hourly rows now present for 03:00-06:00 UTC for org 7421. Charts populated.
michael: Customer confirmed via email. Thanks. Filing follow-up ticket to revert writer change and add automated detection for duplicate-key backfill failures + alerting.
raj: +1 on follow-up. Will create ticket and schedule postmortem.
sasha: Leaving note: add consumer/leader-change playbook to reduce leader-shuffle impact on ingest.
emily: Closing once the follow-up ticket exists. :thumbsup:
